## 正文

## Summary

- Restrict 256-bit PTX global load/store paths to SM100+ with CUDA 12.9+.
- Use the 128-bit fallback paths on older architectures.
- Add pre-SM100 CUDA tests for `T.ldg256`/`T.stg256` and vector-store fallback behavior.

## C++ style / lint notes

- The PR changes C++ code but does not change `docs/developer_guide/cpp_style.md`.
- CI defines a “C++ API Style Audit (warning only)” step.
- Its result is unavailable.
- Test execution results are unavailable.
